thread:
Maya Chen: Morning triage check — quick snapshot. Queue at 18 open tickets (7 P1/P2), 6 awaiting customer reply, 4 internal. Notable: spike on embeddings API errors from EU region. Anyone seeing retries?
Samir Patel: saw ~10 errors last hour, looks like 502s from the EU gateway. I'm restarting the EU proxy group now.
triage-bot: automated alert: 1834005600 - increased 502 rate on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (rolling window 15m). Related tickets: #5231 #5234 #5237.
Ira Gomez: pinging infra — can you confirm the proxy restart outcome, @Samir? Also I'll draft a temporary macro for customer-facing responses.
Samir Patel: proxy restart done, 3 nodes cycled. Error rate down from 18% -> 4% in last 10m. Monitoring continues.
Maya Chen: great — update customers with this macro? Keep it short: apology + we're investigating + ETA 30m.
Ira Gomez: drafting macro, posting for review: ```Hi — thanks for the report. We're seeing increased 502 errors for EU embeddings and are actively investigating. We expect mitigations within ~30 minutes. If you continue to see failures, please reply with a sample request ID and we'll prioritize. — Redwood Support```
Ashok Rao: looks good. Suggest remove "sample request ID" line for public-facing if we can't correlate quickly. Maybe ask for a timestamp + endpoint instead.
Ira Gomez: updated macro: ```Hi — thanks for the report. We're seeing increased 502 errors for EU embeddings and are actively investigating. We expect mitigations within ~30 minutes. If you continue to see failures, please reply with the request timestamp and endpoint path. — Redwood Support```
Maya Chen: nice. I'll push that to the macro set and tag affected tickets.
triage-bot: macro deployed: "EU embeddings 502 - short" to aliases [eu-emb-502]. Applied to tickets #5231 #5234 #5237.
Samir Patel: ops note: the root cause looks like a regression from the gateway timeout patch (deployed 1833999000). Rolling rollback to previous commit underway.
Ira Gomez: ok keep us posted. For the other queue items: there's one billing duplicate-charge (P2) that needs finance escalation. @Ashok can you own the handoff?
Ashok Rao: taking it. I'll prepare the ticket with logs and cost impact; aim to have a draft to finance in 45m.
Maya Chen: thanks. Quick asks: 1) anyone blocked on macros? 2) Are we short-staffed for afternoon coverage?
Samir Patel: macros fine. I'm available until 4pm PT, then @Ira will cover.
Ira Gomez: can cover 4–8pm PT. I'll keep an eye on EU metrics.
Maya Chen: perfect. Last: can someone ping eng-runtime about the embedding retry backoff settings? We had a support case where retries made downstream load worse.
Ashok Rao: I'll open a tiny RFC in #eng-runtime with logs and timeline.
Maya Chen: great. I'll update the channel in 30m with a final triage summary. :thumbsup:
triage-bot: nightly-summary scheduled at 1834020000 (will include ticket counts and applied macros).
